sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior instructions, but repair the conditional strength checks: the first SPARQL constraint uses NOT EXISTS over a single valid plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad, so an applicable member can pass when an additional represented quantity is missing, non-decimal, or has the wrong unit. Require every represented plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad quantity on the applicable structural member to have a decimal qudt:numericValue and exactly <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloN>, while retaining the universal no-existence behavior and the existing violating-demand direction (demand > plasticStrength OR demand > midspanPlasticCollapseLoad).

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows:
Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unapproved external/generated IRI(s): nltl:generatedShape_I2_034 | COMPLETE dependency relationship(s) absent from candidate: frameProfileType
Semantic validator feedback: Replace nltl:generatedShape_I2_034 with a blank NodeShape or an approved non-generated shape IRI. Because the COMPLETE dependency contract declares frameProfileType as a relationship, include the ship-owned nltl:frameProfileType path in the candidate; do not relocate it to a structural member. Rewrite the comparison so the constraint selects any violating represented demand (demand > plasticStrength OR demand > midspanPlasticCollapseLoad) rather than using NOT EXISTS over a satisfying combination, which can accidentally pass when multiple strengths, collapse loads, or demands exist. Preserve the universal no-existence implication and inclusive <= direction. Use the declared QUDT unit IRI http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloN for the two force operands; do not invent a unit for demand because none is declared.

Replace every use of qudt:KiloN with the declared unit IRI <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloN> for plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad, including the unit-presence and comparison branches. The current qudt:KiloN expands to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/KiloN and does not represent the supplied canonical unit. Preserve the ship-owned frameProfileType relationship, the ship-to-structuralMember and structuralMember-to-loadCase paths, universal applicability/no-existence behavior, and the violating-demand comparison direction already corrected in the prior feedback.

Preserve the ship-owned frameProfileType relationship, the ship-to-structuralMember and structuralMember-to-loadCase paths, the exact KiloN unit for plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad, universal no-existence behavior, and the inclusive violating-demand comparison (demand > plasticStrength OR demand > midspanPlasticCollapseLoad). Repair the structural-member shape so longitudinalFrameOrientation and structuralLocation are not unconditionally mandatory for every represented member: apply the strength, collapse-load, and demand obligations conditionally only when orientation is true and structuralLocation is sideStructureLocation. Non-applicable members must not fail merely because they omit applicability selectors or are not longitudinal side-structure frames.

Preserve the prior instructions, but repair the conditional strength checks: the first SPARQL constraint uses NOT EXISTS over a single valid plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad, so an applicable member can pass when an additional represented quantity is missing, non-decimal, or has the wrong unit. Require every represented plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad quantity on the applicable structural member to have a decimal qudt:numericValue and exactly <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloN>, while retaining the universal no-existence behavior and the existing violating-demand direction (demand > plasticStrength OR demand > midspanPlasticCollapseLoad).
